data.title: 红莲 · 繁华都市街头并肩漫步
data.description: 华灯初上的都市步行街，换上现代干练便服的红莲与你并肩漫步。两人共享同一副有线耳机听着欢快的旋律，红莲好奇又俏皮地歪头看着你，十指紧扣不放。
data.location: vibrant pedestrian shopping street at twilight

data.promptProse: White-haired Scarlet wears one red wired earbud as she crosses the lively shopping street at twilight. The commander at her side has short dark hair and a dark blue utility jacket. He wears the other earbud, the joined cord hanging between their separate shoulders as they hold hands.
